# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Welcome to your beautiful new home. This luxurious 4-bedroom house offers a spacious and elegant living experience. With 3 bathrooms, including 2 ensuite, there is ample convenience and privacy for the new owners. The kitchen, featuring a central island, is perfect for culinary enthusiasts and creates a focal point for socializing.
